rule: These cases test fail-closed extraction behavior. They do not assert anything about the integrity of a real paper.

cases.required_behavior: Without an exact display-item locator, a row label repeated across multiple tables must not be promoted.
A continuation table must not inherit parent-table identity unless the continuation relationship is explicitly resolved.
If the same row appears in multiple panels, panel identity is required before field promotion.
Footnote numerals or significance annotations must not be bound as coefficient, standard-error, statistic, or p-value fields.
Ambiguous OCR-like substitutions such as O/0, l/1, Unicode minus loss, or split decimals must abstain unless independently resolved.
